$comment: The scope registry. This file must live where the repositories it governs cannot write to it —
a separate, restricted repository, alongside the trusted enforcement workflow. StandardsEnforcer
refuses a registry located inside the repository being assessed.
Entries are keyed by immutable platform identity, never by name. `acme/moneyball` can be renamed,
transferred, deleted and recreated by somebody else; a decision that follows a name follows
whoever holds the name today. `name` is present for humans and is never matched on.
`reviewedFootprint` is the evidence basis: the set of ML signal kinds observed at review time and
its digest. It is what makes a decision able to go stale, and a decision that cannot go stale
cannot be trusted to be fresh. Obtain it with `node scripts/footprint.mjs <dir>`.
An out-of-scope entry needs exactly the same quality of record as an in-scope one. An exclusion
is a governance decision, not an absence of evidence.
